title: Eternal Father
description: The opening prayer of the Divine Mercy Rosary.
body: Eternal Father, I offer You the Body and Blood, Soul and Divinity of Your dearly beloved Son, Our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.

title: For the Sake of His Sorrowful Passion
description: The small bead prayer of the Divine Mercy Rosary.
body:
For the sake of the sorrowful Passion of our Lord Jesus Christ,
_have mercy on us and on the whole world._

title: Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One
description: The closing prayer of the Divine Mercy Rosary, recited three times.
body: Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world.
